name: create_task
description: Create a scheduled task that will later execute through the Subagents MCP server. The task stores a prompt, schedule, target model or agent, and optional skills or MCP integrations to enable at run time.

name.description: A concise 3-5 word display name generated from the task prompt. Infer this name yourself; do not ask the user to provide one.

prompt.description: An action-oriented job specification for the future agent. Use first-person owner wording such as 'Remind me' or 'Check my'; do not supply assumed output or save conversational text that could be mistaken for advice addressed to the model.

model_id.description: The target Open WebUI model or agent ID to execute through subagents_run_subagent.

schedule.description: Schedule definition. Use kind='cron' with a 5-field crontab plus timezone for recurring tasks, or kind='once' with run_at plus timezone for one-off tasks.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret recurring wall-clock schedules and preserve them across daylight-saving changes. Default to the current user's timezone when they did not name another zone.

skill_ids.description: Optional skills to pin for every run. Leave empty by default: scheduled agents can activate relevant skills ad hoc from the task instructions.

tool_server_ids.description: Optional MCP servers or integrations to enable when the scheduled task starts.

enabled.description: Whether the task should be eligible for scheduled execution immediately.

name: get_task
description: Fetch a single scheduled task by id.

name: list_tasks
description: List scheduled tasks stored in the Application Support scheduled_tasks directory.

include_disabled.description: Include disabled tasks in the response.

name: update_task
description: Update mutable fields on a scheduled task. Replacing the schedule or toggling enabled recomputes next_run_at from the current time.

prompt.description: Replacement action-oriented job specification for future runs. Use first-person owner wording such as 'Remind me' or 'Check my' rather than referring to 'the user', and do not supply assumed output or conversational text.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for recurring wall-clock evaluation. Default to the current user's timezone unless the task explicitly uses another zone.

skill_ids.description: Optional skills to pin for every run. Leave empty to allow ad-hoc skill activation from the task instructions.

name: run_task_now
description: Start an immediate run of a scheduled task and return a handle (run_id, chat_id) without waiting for completion. The run executes asynchronously through the scheduling daemon; poll get_task to see last_run_* once it terminates. Idempotent: if a run is already in flight for the task, the existing handle is returned with status=already_running. Use cancel_run to abort an in-flight run.

name: cancel_run
description: Cancel an in-flight run for a scheduled task. Sets a cancellation marker observed by the upstream subagent polling loop; the run terminates asynchronously and last_run_status becomes 'cancelled'. Returns immediately. If no run is in flight, status='no_run_in_flight'. Optional run_id ensures the call targets a specific run (returns an error on mismatch).

task_id.description: Scheduled task id whose in-flight run should be cancelled.

run_id.description: Optional: only cancel if the in-flight run has this run_id.

name: finalize_run
description: Internal scheduled-run finalizer. Scheduled task subagents MUST call this exactly once before ending the run. A scheduled run is only marked successful when this tool records status='success'.

task_id.description: Scheduled task id for the active run.

status.description: Assistant's explicit verdict for whether the scheduled task completed its requested work.

summary.description: Brief user-facing summary of the outcome.

reason.description: Required when status is failed or needs_attention; optional detail for success.
